sanskrit_verse:
यद् विनागममप्यूर्ध्वं भुक्तं पूर्वैस्त्रिभिर्भवेत् ।
न तच्छक्यमपाकर्तुं क्रमात्त्रिपुरुषागतम् ॥
transliteration: yad vināgamam apy ūrdhvaṃ bhuktaṃ pūrvais tribhir bhavet | na tac chakyam apākartuṃ kramāt tripuruṣāgatam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which has been received or consumed without formal acquisition, yet sequentially offered by three prior persons in order, cannot be rejected or undone according to the lawful succession of transmission.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through sequential validation, not individual assertion.
Causation is established via uninterrupted lineage of conscious transfer.
Capacity-based responsibility arises only upon acceptance within a consecrated chain.
Restoration logic honors continuity over fragmentation.
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of inherited dharmic position.
executable_legal_axioms: IF property or right has passed through three successive valid transmitters THEN it becomes irrevocable by any subsequent claimant.
IF an entity receives without initiating formal acquisition AND the source is part of a tri-generational chain THEN rejection is void.
NO reversal of transaction allowed IF transmission follows uninterrupted triadic consecration.
ACCEPTANCE within ordered lineage creates irreversible capacity for stewardship.
supreme_court_application: In matters involving inheritance, title disputes, or ritual succession, the Supreme Court shall recognize that legitimacy conferred through three continuous, conscious transmissions overrides isolated claims of ownership or renunciation. The threshold of responsibility lies in alignment with the consecrated lineage, not personal intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that what enters the flow of dharma through lawful succession cannot be unmade. Anupūrvaśaḥ establishes the inviolability of sequential offering. Proportional responsibility rests with those who seek disruption, not with those aligned with continuity. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that no corrective suffering is required—only realignment with the consecrated order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Acknowledge and affirm the sanctity of the tri-generational chain.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage alignment with the consecrated lineage.
Capacity Restoration: Re-establish rightful custodianship through conscious reaffirmation.
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate ceremonial or legal reconnection with the lawful sequence.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Transmission through three consecrated generations establishes irrevocable truth. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
